v35 controls: HUD appearance > Detailed JARVIS engineering view; Enhanced SHIELD map effects; Animate SHIELD map; Cinematic refresh interval.

The default refresh interval is five minutes. It waits while speaking, thinking, paused, in Showcase or reduced/off motion. Refreshes replay visual boot effects without repeating the startup greeting. Off disables periodic replay.

Enhanced SHIELD uses movie-inspired teal geography, amber illustrative archive markers, coordinate labels and reference-region effects. These are decorative annotations, not live surveillance or claims about canonical character locations. Geography remains based on the bundled Natural Earth data. The user-provided screenshots and Reddit link were visual references.

JARVIS's new engineering view uses real PC telemetry. Theme colors still apply. Turning the engineering toggle off restores the simpler reactor view. The command card now measures its content and selects a free position; long replies remain a concise preview with the full response available through the existing conversation view.
